senses.gloss: m. (פחה, cmp. פּוּחַ) blowing out, expiration; פ׳ נפש (cmp. מַפָּח) despair, disappointment.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 127b:2">Sabb. 127ᵇ</cite> <he>הלך לביתו בפ׳ נ׳</he> went home in despair.

<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:6">R. Hash. II, 6</cite> <he>כדי שלא יצאו בפ׳ נ׳</he> that they (the witnesses) might not leave in disappointment (and be discouraged from coming again); a. fr.—[Levy Talm. Dict. reads <cite ref="Q00468"><he>פַּחֵי</he></cite>, as constr. pl. of <cite ref="Q00440"><he>פַּח</he> III</cite>.]
